messages: sara: quick accessibility sweep on the console update — spotted two things: 1) focus ring on model list rows is very faint in dark theme, 2) the Run Model modal traps focus but the tab order skips the 'advanced options' toggle. attaching screenshots: https://redwood-assets.internal/snap/console-focus-1.png :eyes: alejandra: thanks — good catches. contrast looks below 3:1 against the row bg when using the faint ring. WCAG AA requires 3:1 for UI components. can you paste the hex? sara: row bg is #0f1720, current ring color is #3b82f6 at 16% opacity (looks like #11223a approx). seems ~2.2:1 by quick check with Colour contrast plugin. tom: yikes. For focus we should prefer a solid visible ring for keyboard users. proposal: `outline: 3px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px;` in dark theme, and `outline: 2px solid #0b5fff` in light theme. also avoid relying on box-shadow alone (inconsistent on low-contrast backgrounds). ryan: can we avoid changing visual density too much? product worried about too-thick outlines looking noisy in lists. maybe only show ring on keyboard focus and use a subtler hover state? alejandra: agreed on keyboard-only focus. we can show focus on :focus-visible only. that way mouse users won't see it. still needs to meet 3:1 when visible. tom: quick CSS snippet I tested: ``` .row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #60a5fa; /* meets 3:1 on #0f1720 */ outline-offset: 2px; } .row:hover, .row:focus:not(:focus-visible) { box-shadow: none; /* keep hover subtle */ } ``` works in Chromium/FF. safari support for :focus-visible is OK now but we can polyfill if needed. sara: nice. also found an ARIA nit in the modal: when advanced options expand, there's no announcement for screen readers. the expand toggle uses `aria-expanded` but the region doesn't have `aria-hidden` toggles or an `aria-live` to announce content change. alejandra: for disclosure, best pattern is the content is present in DOM and we update `aria-expanded` on the button. if the content is dynamically injected, use `aria-live="polite"` on the container or a role="region" with aria-label. avoid `aria-hidden` toggling unless you also manage focus. ryan: found a keyboard flow bug: when the modal opens, focus is set to the modal container, not to the first focusable control. tabbing from there jumps to the page behind in some cases. reproduction steps in thread: open modal -> press tab twice -> focus lands on the header behind the modal. access-bot: automated scan (axe) result: 8 violations found — top severity: color-contrast (4 instances), focus-order (2 instances), aria-allowed-attr (1 instance), skip-link-hidden (1 instance). Report: https://ci.redwood/axe/1745126789 tom: for focus-order I'll add a small JS helper to trap keyboard focus inside the modal in the standard way (first focusable -> last focusable loop). we already have a focus-trap util but the modal was updated and missed the hook. I'll patch. alejandra: microcopy: change the toggle label from "More" to "Show advanced options" for clarity and make the button aria-expanded attribute more explicit. also add `aria-controls="advanced-options-panel"` and give the panel `id="advanced-options-panel" role="region" aria-label="Advanced options"`. sara: good call. for toasts (success/error) accessibility we should set `role="status" aria-live="polite"` and ensure they don't steal focus. quick check: success toast currently uses `role="alert"` which forces immed focus in some screen readers — maybe switch to `status` for non-critical notifications. ryan: I'll run the updated code through axe and VoiceOver after the changes. timeline: I'll aim to have a patch + test by EOD tomorrow. tom: assigning myself to the focus ring + focus-trap fix. I'll open a PR and mark it WIP. :white_check_mark: alejandra: I'll update the ARIA attributes and microcopy in the modal component. leaving small comments in the PR for examples. sara: thanks team. action items summarized: 1) tom: focus ring + focus-trap PR (due tomorrow EOD) 2) alejandra: aria/microcopy PR 3) ryan: run axe + screen reader test and post results 4) sara: follow-up visual QA in dark + light theme. I'll add a checklist in the ticket. ryan: noted. will also add a unit test that checks focus-visible is applied and contrast ratio for the ring color against the row bg. alejandra: one last tiny thing — add a skip link to top of console pages (`Skip to content`) and ensure it's revealed on keyboard focus. small win for keyboard users. sara: agreed — small wins matter. thanks all :sparkles:
